Specialized Services to Clear Your Record & Restore Your Future

Every credit challenge has a lawful solution under South African credit legislation. Discover how our 5 core pillars help you break free from debt entrapment.

01
NCA Section 71 Form 17.W

Debt Review Assistance & Removal

Being placed under debt review prohibits you from taking out new credit, buying a car, or obtaining a mortgage bond. If you have paid your creditors, were wrongfully placed under review without proper consent, or have experienced improved financial circumstances, we file the required court applications or NCR clearance documentation (Form 17.4 & 17.W) to expunge the flag from the NCR Debt Help System (DHS) and all credit bureau records.

DHS Clearance Court Rescission of 86(7)(c) Orders Official 17.W Certificate
Avg. 7 - 21 Days Inquire on WhatsApp
02
NCA Section 126B Prescription Act 68 of 1969

Disputing Prescribed Debts

In South Africa, unsecured debt (credit cards, personal loans, store accounts, cell contracts) prescribes after 3 years if you haven't made a payment or acknowledged the debt in writing and no summons was served. Under Section 126B of the NCA, it is illegal for debt collectors to collect on or harass you for prescribed debt. We serve formal legal notices extinguishing these claims and erasing them permanently from your bureau profile.

Stop Harassing Calls Extinguishment of Old Debt Bureau Balance Zeroed
Fast Legal Resolution Dispute via WhatsApp
03
NCA Section 72 National Credit Bureau Protocol

Remove Negative Listings

Adverse classifications such as "Handed Over", "Written Off", "Default", or "Slow Payer" destroy your credit reputation even after the account is settled or when proper 20-business-day notices were not delivered. We lodge formal Section 72 disputes with TransUnion, Experian, XDS, and Compuscan to challenge flawed data and force the prompt removal of adverse tags.

Adverse Flags Expunged Paid-up Letters Registered Clean Repayment History
20 Business Days Max Remove Listings
04
Score Optimization Target 720+

Improve Your Credit Score

Having a low score means sky-high interest rates or flat-out rejections from major South African banks. Our credit optimization protocol addresses credit utilization ratios, removes redundant search inquiries, restructures exposure, and rebuilds your positive bureau trajectory so you can comfortably cross the 720+ prime threshold.

Credit Utilization Advisory Inquiry Purging Prime Bank Tiering
Continuous Uplift Boost Score
05
Magistrate's Court Act Rescission of Judgment

Clear Judgments and Defaults

Court judgments remain on your credit record for up to 5 years unless actively rescinded by court order or proved paid under the amended National Credit Act. We prepare the necessary settlement affidavits, obtain consent to rescind from plaintiff attorneys, and lodge rescission orders at Magistrate Courts across South Africa.

High & Magistrate Court Filing Consent Paper Drafting Bureau Judgment Purge
Official Court Orders Clear Judgments
